arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Mahoney argued the Tenth Circuit correctly denied the relator a share.
Ms. Vullo argued the relator is an original source under the statute.
Justice Scalia questioned if the government should also be barred from recovery if the relator is not an original source.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the False Claims Act. It asks if a relator must be an original source to share in a fraud award. The lower court denied the relator a share. The government disagrees with that result.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Rockwell wants the court to deny the relator a share of the award.
The United States wants the court to allow the relator to share in the award.
